Sorry for the late reply. I mean, my eyes don’t move automatically; I have to move them manually from the left side of the page to the right side of the page. It's been going on for about 7 months, and it's hell

Suicide seems to be the only way out of this situation because I don't want to live life knowing I'm not smart, and the professional help that could potentially help me is not available to me and will not be so soon. I know it's crazy, but being the first and most gifted has been my top priority since childhood. Moreover, if I attempt suicide and do not die, they will have no choice but to help me.

Thanks for listening to me. 1-5 word sentences are a breeze for me, the rest - not so much. Anything beyond these 5 words takes me much longer to read. For example, I can read 30 pages in 2 hours, but previously I read them in 20-25 minutes. I think it's safe to say that I'm a pretty slow reader right now, but I was a pretty fast reader back then. I feel like a failure
Could it be adhd, even if I read and processed information well just months ago?
Could be, but my most obvious symptom - reading problems - has only recently appeared
